mail.memento.text:
Hello {nume},

Your Pigeonrama subscription expires on {data}.
To keep adding and changing pigeons after this date, pay the subscription for another year. {plata}

Your data is not lost: even without a subscription you can view and print your pigeons.
mail.memento.plata_vanzator: To pay and activate, contact the person you got the program from.

mail.parola_uitata.text:
Hello {nume},

Someone (hopefully you) asked for a new password for your Pigeonrama account.
Open the link below within one hour and choose your new password:

{link}

If you didn't ask for this, do nothing: your password stays the same.
mail.cont_nou.text:
Hello {nume},

We've created an account for you in Pigeonrama, the program for keeping records of your pigeons and their pedigrees.
Open the link below within 7 days and choose your password; then you'll go straight into your loft:

{link}

Only you choose the password; nobody else can see it.

{link}

Only you choose the password; nobody else can see it.

To sign in to your Pigeonrama account, open the link below within 24 hours and choose a new password:

{link}

eroare.sex_e_mama: This pigeon is already the dam of young birds in the program, so its sex can't be changed. First change the parents of those young birds.

eroare.tata_mama_acelasi: The sire and the dam can't be the same pigeon.
eroare.tata_mascul: The sire must be a cock.
eroare.mama_femela: The dam must be a hen.
eroare.deja_urmas: The chosen pigeon is already a descendant of this pigeon.
eroare.generatii_interval: The number of generations goes from 1 to {max}.

eroare.link_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask the fancier for a new one.
eroare.deja_al_tau: This pigeon is already in your loft.
eroare.vanzare_primita: The sale has already been received.
eroare.vinde_doar_proprii: You can only sell pigeons from your loft.
eroare.cumparator_fara_cont: There is no account with this email. The buyer must first create a Pigeonrama account, and the account must be active.
eroare.emailul_tau: This is your own account's email.
eroare.deja_vandut: This pigeon has already been sold.

form.import_titlu: Import a pedigree: do you have it on paper, as a PDF or as a photo?
form.import_text: Enter it all at once (the pigeon and its ancestors), or let the app read it from a photo.
form.qr_titlu: Does it have a Pigeonrama QR code?
form.qr_text: Scan it: the fancier’s pedigree opens and you add it with all its ancestors.
form.ciorna_pastrata: We kept what you wrote last time.

form.coi_pui: Their young bird has an inbreeding of

form.arunci_titlu: Discard what you wrote last time?
form.arunci_rand: The form goes back to the saved details.

retea.intro: Each pigeon appears only once. Thick border: a pigeon with several descendants here, where the bloodlines meet. Tap a pigeon to see its branches.
retea.doar_cei_mai_tineri: Showing only the {n} youngest pigeons. Choose a pigeon to see its relatives.
retea.adauga_primul: Add your first pigeon, then you will see it here with its ancestors and descendants.
retea.pornind_rest: : ancestors over 5 generations and descendants over 3.
retea.legenda_tm: S+D = ancestor of the pigeon on both the sire’s and the dam’s side
arbore.atinge_unul: tap one to see its family tree
arbore.aria_vederi: How you see the family tree
arbore.adauga_primul: Add your first pigeon, then you will see its family tree here.
arbore.confirma_pornire_titlu: Open the family tree with ‘{vedere}’ from now on?
arbore.confirma_pornire_text: You can change it any time with the view switch.
arbore.evantai_cum: Tap a slice to select it; double-click opens the record. Colour = score (grey = not in your loft), stripe = cock / hen, coloured outline = an ancestor that repeats.
arbore.sange_cum: Thickness = how much blood it brings · colour = the bloodline (the founder). Tap a bloodline, in the bar or in the list, to show only that one. The founder’s bloodline comes from the ‘Bloodlines’ field in the record (or from the original breeder).
arbore.sange_necunoscut: Unknown, {procent} %: parents not entered in the app.
arbore.sange_se_intalnesc: This is where the bloodlines meet.
perechi.intro: Each season’s pairs, eggs and young birds. Ringed young birds join the loft with their sire and dam already filled in.
perechi.sex_lipsa: For a pair, the pigeons must have their sex entered on the record (C or H).
perechi.coi_ar_avea: The young birds of this pair would have an inbreeding of
perechi.coi_au: The young birds of this pair have an inbreeding of
perechi.fara_stramosi_comuni: The cock and the hen have no known common ancestors: the young birds are not inbred.
perechi.doar_planuiesc: Just planning it (not put together yet)
perechi.serii_intro: Write the first and last ring of the series you received from the federation. When you ring young birds, the app suggests the next free ring.
perechi.sterge_seria_text: Pigeons already ringed stay as they are; rings from this series are just no longer suggested.
perechi.ponte_dupa: Clutches can be added once you put the pair together.
perechi.ies_intre: The young birds should hatch between {de} and {pana}.

perechi.puii_raman: The ringed young birds from it stay in the loft.
perechi.sterge_perechea_text: Its clutches are deleted too. Ringed young birds stay in the loft.
culori.titlu: Likely colours of the young birds
culori.nu_stim: We don’t know for both parents:
culori.nu_stim_rest: This part is left out of the calculation; you can fill it in below.
culori.corecteaza: Correct the parents’ colours (what you know better)
culori.parinte_neuniform: One of its parents was not spread
culori.nota: These are percentages, not guarantees: a pigeon can carry hidden what does not show in its feathers. The calculation uses classic pigeon genetics (sex-linked base colour and dilute, pattern and spread); pied, grizzle, white and other genes are not included.

concurs.intro: All your pigeons in the same race, at once: choose the race, write the distance once and the place for each pigeon.
concurs.lipeste_cum: If you have the results written somewhere else, you can copy them from there and paste them here. The text is read only on your phone: we keep only your rows, by your fancier code or by your pigeons’ rings.
concurs.codul_tau: Your fancier code (from the result list)
concurs.codul_ajutor: As it appears in the CODE column of the result list, for example VL9001. You write it only once.

concurs.lipire_fara_cod: Your pigeons’ rings were not found. Also write your fancier code, so we can find all your rows.
concurs.lipire_fara_antet: The result list header (date, release point, organiser) was not found: fill them in below.
concurs.distanta_ajutor: Only once for all the pigeons. For the same release point, it fills in by itself next time.

cuib.nu_inelez_text: Young birds without a ring are removed from the clutch (e.g. they died) and ringing no longer shows in the panel. You can change this on the pair's record.
cuib.nu_mai_urmari_text: The clutch leaves the panel and its notifications stop, including the last ringing day. You can press ‘Follow again’ on the pair's record at any time.

excel.intro: Have your pigeons in an Excel table or another program? Bring them all in here at once. Rings you already have aren't duplicated, and the family tree links up by itself from the sire and dam.
excel.fisier_ajutor: The file is read here, on your phone or computer, and isn't sent anywhere.
excel.sau_lipeste: or paste the table copied from Excel here
excel.lipeste_ph: Select the table in Excel, copy it (Ctrl+C) and paste it here (Ctrl+V).
excel.fisier_mare: The file is too big (10 MB at most). In Excel, save just the sheet with the pigeons and try again.
excel.fisier_necitit: We couldn't read the file. Try an .xlsx, .xls or .csv file, or copy the table from Excel and paste it here.

instalare.explicatie: Put Pigeonrama on your phone's screen, like an app: it opens with one tap, and notifications come with the Pigeonrama name.
instalare.gata: Done: Pigeonrama is on your phone's screen. From now on, open it from there.
instalare.manual: From the browser menu (the three dots ⋮ or the lines ☰) choose ‘Install app’ or ‘Add to Home screen’.
